betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Large Steam Furnace is the bronze base's smelting workhorse — one machine for a whole row of single furnaces: the old EU bill is re-priced in steam, and there are only two levers, §1parallelism§r and §1discounts§r, with higher tiers discounting harder.

Exact rates live in the tooltip; here you learn to read the levers — parallelism sets how much a batch takes in, the discount sets how thirsty each bite is, and the product is your true throughput.

§cThe sky-high number in old manuals was an accident of reading per-tick as per-second — let it go.§r
